shortDescription: AIIMS CRE-5 2026 re-examination notice has been issued. A re-conduct of the CRE-5 examination was scheduled at ION Digital Zone IDZ Sitapura, Jaipur on 07 September 2026.
content:
All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), New Delhi conducted the Common Recruitment Examination (CRE-5) for Group B and Group C posts.

The original CRE-5 CBT schedule was 25 July to 27 July 2026. AIIMS subsequently issued Notice No. 146/2026 dated 31 August 2026 for re-conduct of the CRE-5 examination at ION Digital Zone IDZ Sitapura, Jaipur (RJ0101/RJ0102) on 07 September 2026.

Candidates affected by the re-conduct notice should follow the instructions and examination details mentioned in the official AIIMS notice. The official AIIMS Examination website is the authoritative source for any further CRE-5 result, skill-test or recruitment updates.
